title: ranunculus bonariensis var. phyteumifolius
intro: Ranunculus bonariensis var. phyteumifolius, commonly known as the lesser spearwort, is a plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. The lesser spearwort is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to treat various ailments, including skin irritations and wounds, with its bioactive constituents, such as isothiocyanates, responsible for its antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus bonariensis var. phyteumifolius also exhibit antimicrobial and cytotoxic activities, highlighting its potential in traditional medicine.
